# PetroHill

> Civil and structural CAD drafting, Tekla Structures modelling, structural steel detailing, RCC and rebar detailing (placing drawings and bar bending schedules), brownfield modification drawings and material take-offs for EPC contractors, engineering consultancies and steel fabricators in the energy and industrial sectors. Based in Lahore, Pakistan. Work is produced from approved design information; structural design and approvals stay with the responsible engineer.

## Services

- [Civil & structural CAD drafting](https://www.petrohill.com/services/civil-structural-drafting): general arrangements, framing plans, sections, foundation and equipment-base drawings
- [Tekla Structures & 3D structural modelling](https://www.petrohill.com/services/plant-structural-3d-modelling): structural and plant model support, coordination views and exchange files
- [Structural steel detailing & shop drawings](https://www.petrohill.com/services/steel-detailing-fabrication): assembly, single-part and erection drawings, bolt and material lists
- [Reinforced concrete & rebar detailing](https://www.petrohill.com/services/rcc-reinforcement-detailing): placing drawings and bar bending schedules
- [Brownfield structural modifications & as-builts](https://www.petrohill.com/services/brownfield-structural-modifications): existing, removed and new work drawings for operating facilities
- [Material take-offs & documentation](https://www.petrohill.com/services/material-takeoffs-documentation): structural MTO, BOM and drawing registers
- [Engineering outsourcing](https://www.petrohill.com/engineering-outsourcing): subcontract drafting, modelling and detailing support
